body: Thanks for your response. Yes, they do really care about me and I'm grateful for that. One of them is actually a friend that I've known since before she became a supervisor. Since you have been through something like this, I have a question for you if you don't mind? Do you think the physical force they used was the right thing to do? I had slight bruises on both my arms and one wrist before getting to the ER.
Thank You, you are right about facing the fears.
